stem.title: STEM Racing
stem.subtitle: What is it?
stem.body_part_1: STEM Racing, formerly known as F1 in Schools, is an international educational program that encourages
stem.body_part_2: to learn about science, technology, engineering, and mathematics (
stem.body_part_4: . The program promotes hands-on learning and helps students develop essential skills such as teamwork, problem-solving, and project management.

timeline.label: Our Journey
timeline.title: From Luxembourg to the World Stage
timeline.body_part_1: We are a student-led team from the
timeline.body_part_2: Since 2022, we have been pushing the boundaries of engineering and design to represent our country in the world's most prestigious STEM competition.

item1.title: Team Creation
item1.text: In October 2022, the first generation of Icarus was formed with our founding members: Celia, Nikos, Lukas, and Maria.

item2.title: National Competitions
item2.text: Between 2022 and 2025, we attended three National Finals in Luxembourg and two showruns, winning multiple trophies along the way.

item3.title: World Finals
item3.text: In June 2025, we qualified to represent Luxembourg at the World Finals in Singapore. We worked tirelessly throughout the summer to prepare for the event in September.

sponsors.title: Our Sponsors
sponsors.description: We are immensely grateful to all the sponsors working with us. We could not have embarked on this journey without their support!

past.title: Past Sponsors
past.description: We are proud to have collaborated with these past partners and remain grateful for the lasting impact of their generous support.

efg.name: EFG Bank
efg.description: EFG is our lead sponsor. This journey would not have been possible without them.

eurobank.name: EuroBank
eurobank.description: Eurobank was our first major private sponsor. We are very grateful for their early support.

apeeel2.name: APEEEL
apeeel2.description: We are fortunate to have had the support of our school's parents' association since day one!

esl2.name: European School of Luxembourg II
esl2.description: We are supported by our school, which provides us with a dedicated workspace and essential tools.

dreamcars.name: Dream Cars
dreamcars.description: Dream Cars is a private car dealership in Luxembourg that believes in our mission. Thank you!

ortea.name: Ortea
ortea.description: Ortea produces organic iced tea in Luxembourg and was our very first private sponsor.

delphis.name: Delphis Studio
delphis.description: Delphis Studio is a private 3D design studio. They have provided expert advice on many of our graphics.

ratrig.name: RatRig
ratrig.description: RatRig kindly provided a discount and expedited shipping for our CNC Mill.

gestron.name: Gestron
gestron.description: Gestron specializes in Asset Management and was kind to financially sponsor our journey.

oeuvre.name: Œuvre Nationale
oeuvre.description: Œuvre Nationale support projects, associations and non-profits across Luxembourg, including our journey. Thank you!

partnership.title: Partner With Purpose
partnership.subtitle: Fueling the Next Generation of Engineering
partnership.description: As a self-funded STEM Racing team, our journey to the World Finals is powered entirely by our partners. While financial support is critical for our operations, we highly value technical and material contributions—ranging from precision manufacturing and 3D printing filaments to expert consultancy in aerodynamics, marketing, and visual design.
partnership.cta_note: Every contribution directly accelerates our performance on and off the track.

funds.title: Strategic Fund Allocation
funds.caption: Icarus Gen 2: Aerodynamic validation in the smoke tunnel.

allocation1.title: Global Logistics & Accommodation
allocation1.description: Ensuring the team is stationed at official venues during the international World Finals.

allocation2.title: International Travel
allocation2.description: Transporting our team and equipment to global competition host cities.

allocation3.title: Competition & Entry Fees
allocation3.description: Covering mandatory team registration and individual participant accreditation.

allocation4.title: Advanced Manufacturing
allocation4.description: Sourcing official racing blocks, high-performance paints, and precision tooling.

allocation5.title: Branding & Marketing
allocation5.description: Producing team uniforms, pit displays, and high-impact marketing collateral.

allocation6.title: Sustainability Initiatives
allocation6.description: Partnering with environmental leaders to offset our carbon footprint.

benefit1.title: Education
benefit1.description: Demonstrate your commitment to supporting education and the next generation.

benefit2.title: Innovation
benefit2.description: Showcase your support for innovative ideas, creativity, and future engineers.

benefit3.title: Global & Local Exposure
benefit3.description: STEM Racing is a global competition, and Icarus actively promotes the project both internationally and within Luxembourg.

benefit4.title: Experience
benefit4.description: Icarus has nearly four years of experience in the project—the most of any team in Luxembourg.

benefit5.title: Visibility Everywhere
benefit5.description: We are committed to maximizing your investment by featuring your logo on our materials and through custom arrangements.

benefit6.title: Targeted Audience
benefit6.description: Partnering with us exposes your company to top current and future professionals in STEM fields.

tiers.title: Sponsorship Tiers
tiers.heading: Join The Pantheon
tiers.caption: Choose the sponsorship level that aligns with your goals. Every tier fuels our mission to push the boundaries of engineering excellence.
tiers.cta: Ready to fuel the future of engineering?
tiers.mailto_body: Hi, I'm interested in discussing sponsorship opportunities with your team.

zeus.name: Zeus
zeus.description: Our most prestigious partners. Zeus-tier sponsors provide substantial monetary support that powers our entire operation—from chassis fabrication to international travel.
zeus.perk1: Prime logo placement on the vehicle
zeus.perk3: Prime logo placement in all documents and materials
zeus.requirement_description: Requires substantial monetary investment. Zeus-tier partners are our primary stakeholders, providing the capital necessary for major R&D and international logistics.

poseidon.name: Poseidon
poseidon.description: Strategic partners who drive our technical capabilities. Poseidon-tier sponsors contribute significantly through funding or high-value material donations that shape our car's performance.
poseidon.perk1: Prominent logo placement on the vehicle
poseidon.perk3: Logo placement in key documents and materials
poseidon.requirement_description: Open to significant monetary contributions or substantial in-kind material donations such as high-grade filaments, specialized components, or electronics.

demeter.name: Demeter
demeter.description: The backbone of our daily operations. Demeter-tier sponsors provide essential services and support that keep our team running smoothly throughout the season.
demeter.perk3: Listed as an official team supporter
demeter.requirement_description: Ideal for local businesses or specialists offering technical services, printing, consulting, or entry-level financial contributions.

team.hero_subtitle: From engineers and designers to marketing specialists, Icarus is a collective of students driven by a shared passion for speed, innovation, and the future of STEM.

margaux.bio: Responsible for overseeing all team activities, organizing tasks, managing time, and ensuring effective collaboration across the group.

matej.bio: Brings the car to life through manufacturing and works closely with the design team to ensure precision and performance.

alexandru.bio: Designs, tests, and improves the car using CAD and CFD software to maximize on-track performance.

vasilis.bio: Responsible for managing Icarus’ public image, social media presence, and branding across all platforms. Handles sponsor communication, partnerships, and fundraising activities.

hall_of_fame.title: Hall of Fame
hall_of_fame.subtitle: Commemorating those who built the foundation of Icarus.

gen4.title: Generation IV
gen4.description: Under experienced guidance from Generation III members, a completely new team was established. We worked tirelessly towards the National Finals, a managed to win 2 trophies, and qualify to the World Finals again.

m1.name: Maia
m1.bio: Maia successfully led the team towards a sweet victory during Luxembourg's National Finals in May 2026

m2.name: Tomáš
m2.bio: Tomáš was responsible for designing and testing the car, ensuring we got every competitive advantage possible.

m3.name: Matej
m3.bio: Matej was responsible for turning Tomáš's designs into reality - milling the body, sanding, painting and assembling the final vehicle.

m4.name: Margaux
m4.bio: Margaux handled research, communication, and good collaboration with various sponsors of our team.

m5.name: Alexandru
m5.bio: Alexandru suppored the technical department, easing their workload. He was also the driver having the fastest reaction time of the group.

m6.name: Ana
m6.bio: Ana was responsible for managing Icarus' public image and digital presence. She coordinated and ensured a consistent and professional identity across all platforms.

gen3.title: Generation III
gen3.description: With increased experience, we focused on our primary challenge: sponsorship. We successfully secured the funds needed for the World Finals while enhancing our brand image, car design, and overall team operations.

m1.name: Petar
m1.bio: Petar led Icarus to the World Finals in 2025. He worked closely with every member to ensure quality and cooperation, while also overseeing the manufacturing of the cars.

m2.name: Celia
m2.bio: Celia managed a diverse set of responsibilities, including written and graphic deliverables such as portfolios, uniforms, and banners. As the founder of Icarus, she established our core brand image.

m3.name: Nikos
m3.bio: Nikos was in charge of all design and testing. His responsibility was to develop innovative, high-performance designs to ensure the team remained competitive.

m4.name: Lukas
m4.bio: Lukas served as the finance manager and IT specialist. By handling the budget, financial planning, and IT infrastructure, he ensured the team operated efficiently.

m5.name: Konstantina
m5.bio: Konstantina handled all marketing, public relations, and stakeholder communication, maintaining our strong links with the local community and beyond.

gen2.title: Generation II
gen2.description: Following the success of Gen I, we expanded to six members, upgraded our resources, and began evolving into a top-tier competitive team in Luxembourg.

m1.name: Celia
m1.bio: Celia is the founder and former leader of Icarus. She managed numerous tasks across all fields, ranging from administration to car design.

m2.name: Nikos
m2.bio: Nikos was responsible for balancing performance and design, relentlessly refining every detail to find a competitive edge.

m3.name: Lukas
m3.bio: Lukas managed our online presence. By maintaining our website and facilitating online collaboration, Lukas was instrumental in bringing the team together.

m4.name: Jan
m4.bio: Jan’s creative vision provided our logo and pit display, significantly improving our overall presentation.

m5.name: Rohan
m5.bio: Rohan managed external communications and team funds, providing a financial perspective for all major team decisions.

m6.name: Romeo
m6.bio: Romeo was in charge of marketing strategies and securing sponsorship deals, while also assisting with administrative tasks.

gen1.title: Generation I
gen1.description: Gen I entered the project (then called F1 in Schools) with no prior experience. In just two months, we created a brand and a functional car with minimal guidance.

m1.name: Celia
m1.bio: Celia founded Icarus and led the first generation to success, handling the majority of the team's administrative tasks.

m2.name: Nikos
m2.bio: Nikos was responsible for designing and manufacturing our very first car.

m3.name: Lukas
m3.bio: Lukas led the team in all IT matters, primarily creating and maintaining the first team website.

m4.name: Maria
m4.bio: Maria was our first designer, creating the initial versions of our logo and supporting the team's visual needs.

establishment_22.title: Establishment of the Team
establishment_22.text: Fascinated by Formula 1 and engineering, Celia formed the team and invited Nikos and Lukas to join. We worked tirelessly to create our first car, portfolios, and presentation.

first_event_22.title: Our First Event
first_event_22.text: At our first race at Luxembourg's highest level of competition, we won the ‘Judges’ Favorite Award’ despite our lack of resources. This success set high standards and motivated us to strive for excellence.

expansion_23.title: Three New Members
expansion_23.text: To manage the increasing workload and our vision for the World Championships, we welcomed three new members: Jan, Rohan, and Romeo.

june_event_23.title: June Event
june_event_23.text: Shortly after expanding to six members, we participated in an event where we were awarded ‘Regional T1 Top Team’ for our superior preparation.

showrun_23.title: New School Year Showrun
showrun_23.text: At the start of the 2023 school year, we participated in a Showrun, sharing insights with new enthusiasts and showcasing our journey.

national_finals_24.title: Luxembourg National Finals
national_finals_24.text: Aiming for the World Championships, we ensured every aspect of our entry was top-notch. Although we fell short against experienced competition, we won the ‘Knockout Champions’ and ‘Fastest Car’ awards.

reorg_24.title: Team Reorganization
reorg_24.text: After three members graduated in July, we quickly recruited Petar and Konstantina to ensure the team's continued growth.

showrun_24.title: Showrun 2024
showrun_24.text: Invited back to the Showrun at ISL as one of the most experienced teams, we shared tips with younger participants and won the ‘Best Logo’ award.

prep_24_25.title: Preparation
prep_24_25.text: Alongside our studies, we worked tirelessly on a new car design, upgraded our project management, and pitched to sponsors to secure our qualification for the World Finals.

national_finals_25.title: National Finals 2025
national_finals_25.text: We competed in our third National Finals in May 2025. After three years of hard work, we successfully qualified to represent Luxembourg at the World Finals in Singapore!

world_finals.title: World Finals
world_finals.text: In September, we traveled to Singapore to represent Luxembourg at the World Finals. While we did not take home a trophy, the experience was surreal and propelled Icarus significantly forward.

new_team.title: New Team
new_team.text: With the Generation 3 team starting their universities, they helped to organize a selection process for new members of Icarus. Some of them also regularly help out and mentor the new team.

nationals_26.title: National Finals 2026
nationals_26.text: The new members competed again in Luxembourg's annual National Finals. Gen3 members Petar and Lukas were present during the competition and saw the new team win 'Knockout Champions' and 'T1 Champions' trophies as well as qualify to World Finals 2026.

restructuring.title: Team Restructuring
restructuring.text: After the National Finals, the team sat down and discussed progress, roles, responsibilities and workload. We decided to change the internal structure of the team to best fit the expectations and needs of the members and the whole team.
